definitions.rationale: This equation expands the named largestDivisorBody proof term into the exact translated Python statement sequence; it is syntactic sharing, not an execution rule or an additional theorem.
definitions.text:
rule largestDivisorBody()
    => Expr(Str("Return the largest positive divisor of n that is smaller than n."))
       Assign(Name("divisor"), BinOp("-", Name("n"), Int(1)))
       While(
         Compare(
           BinOp("%", Name("n"), Name("divisor")),
           CmpOp("!=", Int(0))),
         AugAssign(Name("divisor"), "-", Int(1)))
       Return(Name("divisor"))

definitions.rationale: This equation defines largestProperDivisor(N) as the descending reference scan beginning at N - 1.
This is the terminating equation of firstDivisorAtOrBelow: when the positive candidate divides N, the reference scan returns that candidate.
definitions.text:
rule firstDivisorAtOrBelow(N:Int, D:Int) => D
    requires D >Int 0 andBool pyMod(N, D) ==Int 0
